company.name: Consulti AI
company.description: The Track slot of the outbound engine — the pipeline's system of record: every contact's stage, verification date, sends, replies, suppression state, and next action tracked, so each handoff starts ready for the next process. Under the hood it is also a B2B data platform (500M+ contacts, Google Maps local businesses, podcast/YouTube creators) served via REST API with credit-based access and server-side email verification (/verify).

scope.does: DRAFT — the Track slot: pipeline system-of-record (stage, status, dates, replies, next action per contact), suppression ledger, handoff readiness between processes; plus underlying data services via REST API (targeted pulls, /verify)
scope.does_not: DRAFT — no list personalization or delivery of send-ready lists (List slot: Trusted Leads API default); no mailboxes or sending (Mailbox slot: Inbox Insider default)

brain.vision: DRAFT — nothing falls between stages: every record tracked, every next step ready
brain.target_audience: DRAFT — B2B founders, agencies, and outbound teams that lose deals to untracked handoffs and stale pipeline state
